title: Write Vitest unit tests for the interpolation utility
description: Write Vitest unit tests for the interpolate() utility function (TASK-92). Pure function tests — no mocks needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover: simple replacement, dot notation, each blocks, missing keys (keepUnknown=true and false), empty string handling, special characters in values

steps.details: Write tests for each case: `interpolate('Hello {{name}}', { name: 'World' })` === 'Hello World'. Dot notation: `interpolate('{{a.b}}', { a: { b: 'x' } })` === 'x'. Unknown key with keepUnknown=false: replaced with ''. Each block iterates correctly.
